verdict.rationale: OpenTofu is itself an official CLI (`tofu`), with documented commands at opentofu.org/docs/cli/ including plan, test, and import. It supports multiple install methods, an official OCI image, and no-install use. It also offers scriptable features that suit automated and agent use: machine-readable `-json`/`-json-into` output, saved plan files, and the `TF_ENCRYPTION` environment variable. Missing for 10: machine-readable output is evidenced only for `tofu test` rather than across all commands, and there is no agent-specific CLI guidance.
